Business Analyst / Functional Consultant with 8.6 years of experience in Banking and Financial Services, including 6 years of dedicated Business Analysis experience.
Strong domain expertise in Trade Finance, Core Banking and Digital Banking, with hands-on experience across Letter of Credit (LC), Import Finance, Export Finance, Import & Export Bills, Bank Guarantee (BG), Foreign Remittances, FDI and ODI.
Analysed and documented Treasury, Credit, Market, Liquidity Risk, and AML requirements, covering risk exposure, liquidity positions, transaction monitoring, controls, and regulatory reporting.
Collaborated with Treasury, Risk, AML/Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Technology stakeholders to define requirements, workflows, functional specifications, and process improvements.
Experienced in Agile/Scrum and Waterfall delivery, requirements elicitation and analysis, BRD/FRD/SRS, user stories, acceptance criteria, process mapping, gap and impact analysis, stakeholder management, UAT and production validation.
Developed comprehensive project documentation, including requirement specifications, design documents, and test plans, to ensure clarity and alignment among stakeholders and project teams.
Ensuring clear, sequential progression through requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and deployment phases.
Worked closely with product owners and stakeholders to prioritize and manage product backlogs, ensuring that the most valuable features are delivered first and aligned with business objectives.

Import & Export Finance, Foreign Remittances, Regulatory Reporting, and Customer Portal
services. The application integrates with Core Banking Systems and multiple third-party
systems to streamline banking operations and enhance customer experience.
Trade Free is trade finance transaction processing system.
Contributed to the development of Finacle 10 a core banking solution, designed to streamline
banking operations, including account management, payments, and loans. It offers
advanced digital banking capabilities, CRM, and compliance features.
Contributed to the development of Bank Trade software application for scalable, flexible trade
finance solution that meets evolving needs of the bank.
Contributed to the development of Tradex software application for scalable, flexible trade
finance solution that meets evolving needs of the bank. In this project, utilized Agile
methodologies to ensure iterative progress and continuous improvement.

international trade transactions, including Letters of Credit, Bank Guarantees, Import

sections.text:
Profile Summary
Business Analyst / Functional Consultant with 8.6 years of experience in Banking and Financial Services, including 6 years of dedicated Business Analysis experience. Strong domain expertise in Trade Finance, Core Banking and Digital Banking, with hands-on experience across Letter of Credit (LC), Import Finance, Export Finance, Import & Export Bills, Bank Guarantee (BG), Foreign Remittances, FDI and ODI. Analysed and documented Treasury, Credit, Market, Liquidity Risk, and AML requirements, covering risk exposure, liquidity positions, transaction monitoring, controls, and regulatory reporting. Collaborated with Treasury, Risk, AML/Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Technology stakeholders to define requirements, workflows, functional specifications, and process improvements. Experienced in Agile/Scrum and Waterfall delivery, requirements elicitation and analysis, BRD/FRD/SRS, user stories, acceptance criteria, process mapping, gap and impact analysis, stakeholder management, UAT and production validation. Developed comprehensive project documentation, including requirement specifications, design documents, and test plans, to ensure clarity and alignment among stakeholders and project teams. Ensuring clear, sequential progression through requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and deployment phases. Worked closely with product owners and stakeholders to prioritize and manage product backlogs, ensuring that the most valuable features are delivered first and aligned with business objectives.

raw_sections.summary:
Profile Summary
Business Analyst / Functional Consultant with 8.6 years of experience in Banking and Financial Services, including 6 years of dedicated Business Analysis experience. Strong domain expertise in Trade Finance, Core Banking and Digital Banking, with hands-on experience across Letter of Credit (LC), Import Finance, Export Finance, Import & Export Bills, Bank Guarantee (BG), Foreign Remittances, FDI and ODI. Analysed and documented Treasury, Credit, Market, Liquidity Risk, and AML requirements, covering risk exposure, liquidity positions, transaction monitoring, controls, and regulatory reporting. Collaborated with Treasury, Risk, AML/Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Technology stakeholders to define requirements, workflows, functional specifications, and process improvements. Experienced in Agile/Scrum and Waterfall delivery, requirements elicitation and analysis, BRD/FRD/SRS, user stories, acceptance criteria, process mapping, gap and impact analysis, stakeholder management, UAT and production validation. Developed comprehensive project documentation, including requirement specifications, design documents, and test plans, to ensure clarity and alignment among stakeholders and project teams. Ensuring clear, sequential progression through requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and deployment phases. Worked closely with product owners and stakeholders to prioritize and manage product backlogs, ensuring that the most valuable features are delivered first and aligned with business objectives.
